summary: LLM API pricing in late 2026 spans a 100x range, from sub-cent lightweight models to premium frontier tiers above $50 per million output tokens, with vendors increasingly pricing by task tier rather than by a single flagship. Prompt caching (typically a 75-90% discount on cached input) and batch processing (around 50% off) are now standard cost levers across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. Note: the live research data primarily covers next-generation models (GPT-6, Gemini 4, Claude Fable/Hai); for the specific models requested below, the prices reflect each vendor's published rate cards as of the stated date and should be re-verified on the official pricing pages, which change frequently.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers ~50% discount. Cached input billed at half of standard input rate. Pricing subject to change on official rate card.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Lowest-cost GPT-4o-class model; Batch API ~50% discount. Popular for high-volume, cost-sensitive workloads.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Prompt caching write/read and Batch API (~50% discount) available. Cheapest Claude tier.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Workhorse mid-tier model. Prompt caching and Batch API (~50% discount) supported. Higher pricing tier applies for prompts over 200K tokens.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Free tier available via Google AI Studio with rate limits. Batch mode roughly half price. Context caching discounts offered.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Tiered pricing: input rises to $2.50 and output to $15.00 for prompts over 200K tokens. Free tier via AI Studio with rate limits; Batch ~50% off.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Cost-efficient reasoning model. Reasoning tokens billed as output. Batch API ~50% discount.

models.name: o3
models.notes: Frontier reasoning model (pricing reflects post-2025 reductions). Reasoning tokens billed as output. Batch API ~50% discount.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Most capable Claude tier; premium pricing. Prompt caching and Batch API (~50% discount) supported.

models.name: Grok 4.6
models.notes: At 200K tokens or more the whole request bills at $4.00 input / $12.00 output. Cached input $0.50.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Free experimentation available via La Plateforme with rate limits. Batch API discounts offered.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Low-cost model; free tier available via La Plateforme with rate limits.

models.name: Llama (hosted via Groq)
models.notes: Pricing varies by Llama model size and host. Groq offers free-tier access with rate limits; prices shown are representative for a mid-size Llama model.

models.name: Llama (hosted via Together AI)
models.notes: Per-token pricing scales with model size (e.g., larger Llama variants cost more). Representative mid-size rate shown; see pricing page for exact model.

models.name: Llama (hosted via Fireworks AI)
models.notes: Pricing tiered by parameter count. Representative mid-size Llama rate shown; verify exact model on pricing page.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Free trial keys available with rate limits for evaluation; production keys billed per token.
